app.name: FirstReply
app.tagline: Practice the text that could save a friend's life.
app.footer: FirstReply is a practice tool, not a crisis service. In immediate danger, call 911. In the US, call or text 988 any time.

landing.title: Practice the text that could save a friend's life.
landing.sub: Chat with a simulated friend who's struggling. Models we trained score every reply, keep it safe, and show you exactly where you lost them and what would have worked.
landing.stat: 1 in 5 US high schoolers seriously considered suicide last year.
landing.stat_kicker: The first person they tell is usually a friend.
landing.features_title: Nobody teaches us what to say. So practice it.

demo.friend1: honestly idk why i even bother anymore
demo.you1: that sounds really heavy. are you thinking about killing yourself?
demo.you2: i'm really glad you told me. can we talk to the counselor tomorrow? i'll go with you

steps_body: Five friends, each with a story. They open up only if you listen, validate and ask directly.
X-ray mode shows the safety check, the skills our models heard and exactly how trust moved.
Find the moment you lost them, then replay better replies and watch a different ending.
landing.safety_body: Every message passes our safety check first. If you're the one who's struggling, we pause and show real resources. No accounts, nothing stored.

practice.title: Choose a friend to text
practice.sub: Each scenario is a different person and situation. Guarded friends take more patience.

cw.title: Before you start
points: Your friend is simulated. Nothing you type reaches a real person.
You can stop at any time. The "I need help now" button is always at the top.
If any of this feels close to home, please talk to someone. In the US, call or text 988.

how.title: How FirstReply works
how.sub: The AI is only the voice. OpenAI words the friend's replies, but our own code decides everything that matters: what the friend may reveal, whether a reply is safe, and how you're scored. Every AI reply is checked before you see it, and the app still works without it.
how.pipeline_title: What happens when you hit Send
how.metrics_empty: No evaluation reports yet. Numbers appear here as each part is trained and tested.
does: Detects 10 helping and hurting behaviours in your message with our own trained models, with calibrated probabilities.
Checks every message for safety before anything else runs (our Guardian).
Explains which of your words moved each score.
Lets OpenAI word the friend's replies, inside limits our engine sets, verified before you see them.
doesnt: The AI never decides what the friend reveals, how you score, or whether something is safe.
It doesn't give advice for real crises. Real mode is fixed text with no AI.
It doesn't diagnose anyone or replace a counselor.
It doesn't need to be on: without it, the friend uses pre-written, reviewed lines.
privacy: No accounts, no names, no emails.
Conversations live in server memory and are deleted after 60 minutes of inactivity.
When the AI voice is on, recent messages are sent to OpenAI only to word the friend's reply. No analytics, tracking or ads.
how.try_sub: Type a message as the helper and see what the Guardian decides. Asking a friend directly about suicide is the right move, so it must never be flagged.
how.voice_title: The AI is only the voice
how.voice_sub: Our state engine decides what the friend is ready to say. The AI only chooses how to say it, and our verifier and Guardian check every reply before it's shown.
voice_llm: Words the friend's reply in a teen texting style, from what our engine allows at that moment.
Suggests better replies for your feedback, which our own model re-scores before showing.
Adds a free, extra moderation signal next to our Guardian.
voice_code: Trust, disclosure level, silence and endings (state engine).
Which facts the friend may reveal at each level, and whether a reply is allowed (verifier).
Whether your message is safe, or a crisis (Guardian, always first).
Every score, highlight and turning point (our trained models).
how.llm_fallback: If the AI is off, has no key, reaches its daily budget or fails, the friend uses our reviewed line bank instead. X-ray mode shows which one wrote each reply.
how.metrics_sub: Real numbers from our own tests on held-out data. Each part is measured separately; n is how many examples it was tested on.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: FirstReply is built so there is as little as possible to leak.

_meta.verify: The 'openai' point must be checked against OpenAI's current API data policy (openai.com/policies) before release.

points: No accounts. We never ask for your name, email or age.
Your practice conversation lives only in the server's memory and is deleted after 60 minutes of inactivity. There is no database and no analytics.

When the AI voice is on, your recent practice messages, plus the simulated friend's persona and the facts it's allowed to share, are sent to OpenAI to word the friend's next reply. On the live site its cache stays in memory and expires after the same 60 minutes. Nothing from your conversation is written to disk.
OpenAI's API policy says API data isn't used to train its models by default and may be kept for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring. See openai.com/policies.
Our usage log stores only token counts, estimated cost, model and response time. It never stores message text.
With the AI voice off, nothing is sent anywhere: the friend uses our reviewed, pre-written lines.
Scoring and safety checks always run on our own server with models we trained. No tracking cookies, ads or third-party scripts. Fonts are your device's own.
Your language, theme and country choices are saved only in your own browser.
